programmes.t: The Haunting of...: Fairuza Balk
programmes.d: After having a traumatizing experience at her studio, Fairuza (American History X, The Craft) wants to know more about the ghosts that live there.

programmes.t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: The Rise of the Fourth Reich (Nazi's in America)
programmes.d: The Allies defeated the Axis Powers on the battlefield, but did they actually win the war? Richard interviews several alternative historians who say that while the German Army may have surrendered in 1945, the Nazi's never officially did.

programmes.t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Did Elvis Fake His Death?
programmes.d: A serious investigation of the long-held theory that Elvis Presley faked his death in August 1977. Jokes of Elvis sightings in Kalamazoo aside, there is a considerable volume of evidence to suggest Elvis may not have left the building

programmes.t: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Manchurian Candidates
programmes.d: Several prominent researchers in the field provide a short history of Mind Control experimentation beginning with the Nazis through to the CIA's infamous MK Ultra program.

programmes.t: Past Hunters: Razor Ruddock's Home
programmes.d: We visit the home of Soccer legend Neil "Razor" Ruddock which seems to be haunted. Is it his home specifically? Or are these ghosts attached to him?

programmes.t: Past Hunters: Blackpool Pleasure Beach
programmes.d: Blackpool Pleasure Beach is one of the most visited attractions in the United Kingdom. People visit it not only for the fun, but to also hopefully catch a glimpse of the many ghosts that haunt there.

programmes.t: Past Hunters: Whitby Hall
programmes.d: Built in the early 1800s, Whitby Hall used to be an administrative center and now stands as a public park and arts center. It has never before been investigated, but staff have reported many noises and presences among them.

programmes.t: My Haunted House: Pest House and Sleepwalkers
programmes.d: An earthquake triggers terrifying activity in a house with a dark past. A young woman sees visions in her sleep that lead her to an abandoned hospital.

programmes.t: My Haunted House: The Whispering and Ethel
programmes.d: After returning home for her mother's funeral, a young woman is terrorized by visions from her past. A musician finds a suicide note that reveals the dark history of his new house.

programmes.t: My Haunted House: The Boy Did It and Frozen Forest
programmes.d: A five-year-old boy claims that his imaginary friend pushed his sister through a second story window. A newly divorced woman relives the terrifying history of the remote cabin she's rented.

programmes.t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Creepy Murder in Room 1046
programmes.d: Ryan and Shane examine the bizarre encounters and baffling twists of the death of Roland T. Owen in Room 1046.

programmes.t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Strange Drowning of Natalie Wood
programmes.d: Ryan and Shane dive into the eerie circumstances involved in the mystery Natalie Wood's tragic drowning.

programmes.t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Mysterious Poisoned Pill Murders / The Disturbing Murders at Keddie Cabin
programmes.d: Ryan and Shane discuss the bizarre case of the Tylenol murders and the truth behind the Keddie Cabin murders.

programmes.t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Suspicious Assassination of JFK
programmes.d: Ryan and Shane explore the theories, evidence and conspiracies around the controversial JFK assassination.

programmes.t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Grisly Murders of Jack the Ripper
programmes.d: Ryan and Shane take a look at the clues to the identity of one of history's most infamous serial killers.

programmes.t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Thrilling Gardner Museum Heist / The Ghastly Cleveland Torso Murders
programmes.d: Ryan and Shane examine America's biggest property crime and explore the case of the Cleveland Torso Murderer.

programmes.t: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Enigmatic Death of the Isdal Woman
programmes.d: Join Ryan and Shane as they unravel the untold secrets involved in the disturbing murder of the Isdal Woman.

programmes.t: My Ghost Story: It Watches Me While I Sleep
programmes.d: The suburban house of two young cousins is filled with scary encounters after a demonic ceramic giraffe is brought into their home.

programmes.t: My Ghost Story: The Axe Murderer
programmes.d: An unknown axe murderer still stalks a family he brutally murdered a century ago and then next-door a spirit with a deadly secret haunts a young couple. An off the beaten path bar is stocked with other worldly spirits.

programmes.t: My Ghost Story: An Entity in Bed
programmes.d: An entity jumps into a woman's bed and lies down beside her; two sisters' ghosts roam a Civil War-era house; a castle built on an old Indian burial ground is haunted by its original owner; and more.

programmes.t: The Haunting of...: Jay Thomas
programmes.d: Jay Thomas (Cheers / Murphy Brown) visits his former home in Santa Barbara, California.

programmes.t: The Haunting of...: Tito Ortiz
programmes.d: Tito Ortiz, (MMA Champion) returns to the Hollywood Hills home where a ghost drove him and his girlfriend Jenna Jameson away many years ago.

programmes.t: The Haunting of...: Kristen Renton
programmes.d: Kristen Renton (Sons of Anarchy / Days of Our Lives) went on a ghost hunt aboard the Queen Mary, a docked ship in Long Beach, CA.

programmes.t: Ghost Dimension: Underground World Of The City of Caves
programmes.d: The Ghost Dimension team ventures underground to investigate the City of Caves in Nottingham.

programmes.t: Ghost Dimension: Lost Souls Of The Tivoli Venue
programmes.d: The Ghost Dimension Team travels to North Wales and the Tivoli Theatre in Flint for a night of haunting entertainment.

programmes.t: Ghost Dimension: The Old Glen and Milner Curse
programmes.d: The Ghost Dimension team heads to Shipley, West Yorkshire to investigate The Old Glen House Pub.

programmes.t: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Tom Arnold, Dee Snider, Carnie Wilson, Nia Long
programmes.d: Tom Arnold takes his teenage anger out on a pipe organ, angering a revengeful spirit; Dee Snider's murdered brother-in-law has a message from the grave.

programmes.t: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Lisa Rinna, Jeffrey Ross, Vincent Curatola, Illeana Douglas
programmes.d: Lisa Rinna's family is haunted by a lonely ghost seeking a family of her own; Vincent Curatola rediscovers his mother's love after she dies.

programmes.t: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Carnie Wilson, Eric Roberts, Elisabeth Rohm, C. Thomas Howell
programmes.d: Carnie Wilson meets the ghost of a drunken barber from the 1890s; Eric Roberts has an out-of-body experience after a car wreck.

programmes.d: This episode includes: Queen Mary Ghost Ship, Update: Carlucci, Two Strikes & UD and Personals Parts 1 & 2 & Update.

programmes.t: Unsolved Mysteries: Episode 5
programmes.d: This episode includes: D.B. Cooper Parts 1 & 2, Update: Math Teacher Escape, Friends to the End & Update and Babe's Uniform & Update.
